expected_outcomes: Release candidates have complete checks, migration, limitations, and recovery evidence.
required_actions: Pass required checks, review sensitive changes, update version and changelog, verify instructions, and define rollback.
expected_documents: Release-readiness report, changelog, migration guide, and rollback plan.
acceptance: No unresolved critical issue remains and controlled tags point to reviewed commits.
verification: Inspect exact-head checks, reviews, documentation, recovery, and critical issue state.
evidence: Readiness report, checks, approvals, and tag target.
failure_conditions: A release proceeds with failed checks, unknown rollback, or unresolved critical risk.
exceptions: Record explicit risk acceptance, approver, scope, and expiry without claiming PASS.
